study: Multi-condition fixed-shot VQLS candidate and independent interval fallback robustness
methods: Ideal-outcome Pauli-sampling, no installed Qiskit/Aer, mpmath.iv interval check not rounding audited
fairness: Same scenario, same initial warm-start and interval uncertainties for all correction methods. Full Newton is a practical classical baseline; damped LU is diagnostic.
limitations: Base-case solved state used as common warm-start for all scenarios; not cold-start realistic deployment.
A single quantum Newton correction is tested, not a complete iterative quantum solver.
IEEE 14 native voltage limits can be violated by generator setpoints; absent thermal limits.
Classical direct solve of baseline state is part of initialization cost; no speedup claims.
